notes.title: IT IS BACK
notes.content:
[i]Hello everyone!
I am finally back with some important changes.[/i]

[b]What's new:[/b]

[u][b]Accuracy[/b][/u]
[i]Starting with the biggest thing on the list, I finally made a [b]significant[/b] change to the AI.
So far the enemy always had the same shooting accuracy. It wouldn't matter if you kept a 100m. distance or a 5m distance. From now on, there are multiple factors on which their accuracy depends on.[/i]
[list]
[b][*] Distance*
[*] Stance**
[*] Speed***[/b] [/list]
*The distance is pretty self explanatory, the further away you are from the enemy the less accurate he is.
**If you are prone, or crouched will also make it harder for them to hit you.
***Walking or sprinting will also help you avoid getting shot.

[u][b]"Heavy Load"[/b][/u]
[i]This feature still needs a lot of work but I have implemented its basis.
Everything you pick up and doesn't replace something else(such as guns) is going to make your
character heavier. The heavier you get the slower you will be able to run, and your stamina will
empty up quicker. For the time being, the only thing you can do to get rid of some of that weight
is to spend ammo and health packs. In the future this system will get more advanced and you
will be able to drop specific items or ammunition if needed.[/i]

[b][u]Health[/u][/b]
[i]As long as I don't have a good animation for the using of a med kit, it is being used instantly.
However, instead of getting +50 HP immediately your HP will now regenerate slowly (+5/sec) until
you get a total of 50.[/i]

[u][b]Difficulty[/b][/u]
[i]For new players, this demo has always been a challenge that in some cases caused them 
to stop trying and give up on it. Therefore some enemies have been removed from the map,
which is going to help them progress easier.[/i]

[b][u]Fixes[/u][/b]
[i]I fixed a few bugs such as:[/i]
[list]
[*] Going full speed while being prone.
[*] Character panting continuously.
[*] Jump Spamming. [/list]

[i][u][b]Help the game with your feedback[/b][/u][/i]
[b]As always your feedback, ideas and bug reports mean everything to me. So please consider
joining our discord where you can directly talk to me, and report bugs. You can find a link
in the game's main menu.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/3779562814566eaefb98290bc7c8d1a0d12a221e.png[/img]

notes.title: A NEW THREAT
notes.content:
A new threat arrived. They are stronger and more accurate than the regular soldiers, and you can't stab them in the back. Make sure to be the one who acquires target first otherwise your chances to win the fight will be close to none. 
In other news, the AI is now able to get all the way up to the sniper tower. So sniping from up there without a risk is no longer an option. Crouch spam got fixed. The recoil has been reworked and looks a lot better now. 

Remember to join our discord server to give me feedback, report bugs and share your experiences. 
https://discord.gg/e3QZEjrHVZ

Cheers.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/bbe0423a98f2cb1bf397c1f8bd3cbc0fcbb17b2d.png[/img]

notes.title: Patching up the big Update. / Official Discord & Twitter
notes.content:
Hello. I just wanted to let you know what was in the latest update (yesterday). 
After adding all this new stuff in the game, some bugs came with that. For example whenever you would go prone underneath a tent, its collision would mess with your character and you would fly on top of the Tent. You were also able to pick up an AR4 even when you already had one. Doing that would mess with your pistol, and it looked as if your pistol was stuck into an AR4. These too and about 10-12 more bugs were fixed yesterday. I expect there to be a few more that I couldn't find when testing the game by myself, so I am asking for your help on this one. Please report any bugs directly on discord or on my twitter. PS The first objective (the backpack) now also saves your game)
Cheers.

Discord: https://discord.gg/TF7PVMSBXr
Twitter: https://twitter.com/lamdaprojects

Support us on IndieGoGo: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/eminus-tactical-fps/x/25868759#/

notes.title: A bunch of new features
notes.content:
Hey hey.
This is a big update with a bunch of new features and improvements.

[b]The Main Menu:[/b]
I've reworked the game's main menu and gave it a way better- more professional look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/554c39fd7fba28596014d131157955fb8058711f.png[/img]

[b]The Settings:[/b]
The game settings are now clearer, plus now you will know which setting you have selected. Instead of just clicking on random ones, not knowing which level of quality(low med high ultra etc) was currently active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/986478722e7db069fa3a7f812b43d7acd0141f7a.png[/img]

[b]The Controls:[/b]
Some of the key bindings are now adjustable. A toggle crouch key was added as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/b5185ef13f3eb58994a4c7629886da586898e6a9.png[/img]

[b]Guns guns guns:[/b]
There are a lot of new guns, attachments etc. Though I only added 2 new ones in the demo. The classic AK which was already there but not usable. And a new tactical AK with Red Dot Sight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/96ef6dc64bdd2ca929e232ef2aca459a6f054f76.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/2812d6d0a2ff6323a4ec1977241ccdeb098085d5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/1ab2715594b9ccf17bbbe565337f69afb11df7a6.png[/img]

[b]Animations:[/b]
Everything has become a lot smoother. The new animations allow you to have a steady, clean aiming, better movement, reloading, leaning and more. Another thing besides the animations is that, the character's left hand is now attached on the gun, so it won't act funny while you move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/6258a23caf7a03609092031b03c566e317efcca4.png[/img]

[b]Non-visual changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The weapon sway changes. There will be some sway even when you crouch or prone. To compensate that, the weapon recoil changes based on your character's state. If you shoot while standing it is going to be "moving" a lot. Going crouch will reduce the recoil a bit, and being prone gives you the best stability you can get. 
[*] The same goes for the AI's accuracy. The lower you get, the harder it is going to be for the AI to hit you.
[*] The AI has better reactions when being shot or shot at.
[*] Reduced the damage you receive from the enemy from -20 to -15 per shot.
[*] Med kits will restore 60 HP (+10 from before).
[*] The sniper's location on the map has changed.
[/list]

[b]Gun Details:[/b]
Amount of recoil: Classic AK > Starter AR4 > AKC (Modded AK)
[b]Damage: [/b]
[list]
[*] AR4: 33
[*] AK: 50
[*] AKC: 50
[/list]
[b]Rate of fire:[/b]
AKC > AR4 > AK

Thank you for playing Eminus. 
Cheers.

notes.title: Kind of a cool update 23th
notes.content:
Hey hey, I've added and changed a few things that I believe will give you a kinda different & improved experience.

[b]Let's start with what has changed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Getting shot at will now feel more realistic, since the AI fires faster but has a bit less accuracy. 
[*] You are now also less likely to get shot while sprinting.
[*] I added about 8 new sound effects for bullets that hit you and bullets that land near you. This adds to the feeling of "panic" when you get shot at. 
[*] I changed and added some sounds you make when a bullet hits you, so there is a variety of sounds now.
[/list]

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*] Aiming is now a smooth transition between the eye- and weapon camera, though I am still working on making the returning camera smooth as well.
[*] You can now kill the enemies quietly by pressing "G".
[/list]

[b]I hope you like the new stuff, feel free to report bugs and give feedback in the discussions.
Cheers[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39782979/3949638f2992bfc9116337e0317eb52abccee756.png[/img]

notes.title: Updates & Fixes
notes.content:
Hello.

I did a few fixes along with some changes in the animations. For instance, before the update you could see what weapon your are holding only when you were aiming. Now you can see which gun is your character holding at the bottom right of your screen(see screenshot).

Removed all unnecessary files from the project, leading to a 90% reduce of game files. (it's less than 2GB).

Improved the checkpoint-save system.

Better gun holding and animations regarding the movement, jumping etc.

And a few more minor changes.

Enjoy

notes.title: Update 8th of February
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]

After receiving plenty of feedback about the difficulty of the game, I decided to drop a small update changing a few things.


[list]
[*] Stationary AI Guards are now firing about 0.6 seconds slower.
[*] All AI guards have now 45% accuracy instead of the previous 50%.
[*] The game saves once after you complete the second objective.
[*] 
[/list]
PS. Saving the game only stores: Location, Killed AIs and the Sniper Rifle if it is already picked up.
I will work on a more advanced saving system and update again when it's.

[i][u]I appreciate your feedback, 
Cheers[/u][/i]
